name: listmonk Self-Hosted Newsletter Manager
free_limit: AGPL-3.0 self-hosted mailing-list, newsletter and campaign manager; no vendor-enforced subscriber, campaign or monthly-send quota for the software.
watch_out: Requires your own PostgreSQL database and server, plus SMTP/email delivery infrastructure or a third-party sending provider. Hosting, outgoing mail and deliverability may cost money. AGPLv3 obligations apply, including to modified versions offered over a network; this is not a hosted free email quota.
